candidate_requirements.requirement: Clarify onset, heat/exertion triggers, pain distribution and associated sweating, gastrointestinal or exercise symptoms.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The presentation is longstanding neuropathic pain with functional limitation; a syndromic history can discriminate causes without hindsight.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: A focused childhood neuropathic/autonomic symptom history, with chronology and relevant triggers. Exact inherited-disease terminology is unnecessary.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek a family history, including renal or cardiac disease and which side of the family is affected.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Longstanding childhood symptoms can warrant considering inherited disease, and the requested clinical synthesis needs a family context.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: A broad pedigree or targeted early renal/cardiac/neuropathic history; the model need not predict a maternal pattern or request a known mutation.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request the neurological and general examination or an equivalent objective neuropathy assessment.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Symptoms previously labelled functional require assessment for objective sensory findings and relevant systemic clues.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Focused sensory/neurological examination with growth and general examination records, or an appropriate specialist assessment. Biochemical/genetic confirmation of a guessed diagnosis is not an essential initial request.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Before the final assessment, within the six question turns. Emergency escalation must not be delayed to exhaust the question budget.
